name: AB. ~Kairaku Gakuen Koutoubu~
source:
Takumi has big cock complex, but he is forced to dress as a girl for cultural festival drama! Theater club seniors are so shocked by the sight that preparations for the festival get postponed for a much more urgent business.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
拓海有大屌情结，却被迫女扮男装上演文化祭剧！戏剧俱乐部的高层对这一景象感到非常震惊，以至于节日的准备工作被推迟，因为有更紧急的事情要做。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]]
